name: Battery storage
description: Businesses that size, install or service home and commercial batteries alongside a solar array, including backup wiring for the circuits you want to keep running during an outage.

name: Rooftop solar
description: Photovoltaic arrays mounted on an existing roof rather than on the ground. Roof age, pitch and material all affect what can be installed, so these businesses typically inspect before quoting.

name: Permit handling
description: Businesses that file building, electrical or utility paperwork on your behalf instead of leaving it with you. Useful when a project needs city inspection or utility approval before it can be energised or occupied.

name: Free estimates
description: Businesses that will scope your job and quote it without charging for the visit. Some cap this at a service radius or a project type, which is noted on each page.

name: Spanish-speaking staff
description: Businesses with staff who handle appointments, quotes and paperwork in Spanish, not only a translated website.

name: Small business taxes
description: Firms that prepare and file returns for sole proprietors, partnerships, LLCs and S corporations, and that can advise on entity choice and quarterly estimates.

name: Monthly bookkeeping
description: Ongoing categorisation and reconciliation on a monthly cycle, usually with a set of reports at month end, as opposed to a once-a-year clean-up.

name: Payroll
description: Running pay cycles, withholding and filings for businesses with employees or contractors.

name: Older homes
description: Contractors experienced with pre-war construction: knob-and-tube wiring, plaster walls, settled framing and historic design review.

name: Accessible design
description: Work planned around mobility needs: curbless showers, grab bar blocking, door widths and step-free entries.

name: Same-day appointments
description: Practices and businesses that hold slots for urgent cases and can usually see you the day you call.

name: Evening hours
description: Businesses open past 5pm on at least one weekday, for people who cannot take time off during the day.

name: Google Business Profile
description: Agencies that set up, verify and maintain the profile that shows your business in Google Maps and local search results.

name: Website build
description: Agencies that build or rebuild a website as a fixed-scope project rather than only running campaigns on top of an existing one.

name: Financing available
description: Businesses that offer payment plans or work with a lending partner so a project does not have to be paid upfront.
